positions.name: INBOARD
positions.text: The jammer program.

positions.name: OUTBOARD
positions.text: The flare program.

controls.text: A four-way hat. Up releases a single chaff and down starts the chaff program. Inboard starts the jammer program and outboard starts the flare program.
controls.context: Chaff is a cloud of metal strips for radar missiles. Flares are hot burning decoys for heat-seeking missiles.

controls.name: Right dispense hat

positions.name: UP
positions.text: A single chaff.

positions.name: DOWN
positions.text: The chaff program.

positions.name: INBOARD
positions.text: The jammer program.

positions.name: OUTBOARD
positions.text: The flare program.

controls.text: The mirrored twin of the left hat, with the same functions.
controls.context: The RIO can use whichever hand is free.

panels.name: RIO: LANTIRN control stick
panels.text: A fixed grip on the RIO's right console, used with the right thumb and fingers. It steers the LANTIRN pod, a targeting pod with a camera and a laser, and fires its laser.
panels.context: The pod finds and marks ground targets. The panel next to the stick holds the power and the laser arm switch.

controls.name: LANTIRN stick: slew hat
controls.text: The centre hat of the stick. Moving it slews the pod left and right and up and down. Pressing it switches between white hot and black hot, two ways of showing heat as light or dark.
controls.context: It aims the pod's camera at the target.

controls.name: LANTIRN stick: S3 hat
controls.text: The left four-way hat on the stick head. Up starts a point track and down starts an area track. Left and right step through the waypoints.
controls.context: A track makes the pod follow the target by itself.

controls.name: LANTIRN stick: S4 hat
controls.text: The right four-way hat on the stick head. Up, right and down pick the quick modes QADL/QHUD, QDES and QSNO, and pressing it steps the declutter level. With the slider it changes the gain, the level, the laser code digits or the focus.
controls.context: The slider decides what the hat does.

controls.name: LANTIRN stick: FOV button
controls.text: The red button on top of the stick. Each press cycles through the three fields of view of the pod, which are how wide an area the picture shows.
controls.context: A narrow field of view magnifies the picture more.

controls.name: LANTIRN stick: mode hat
controls.text: A two-way hat on the side of the stick. Pressing it switches the pod mode between air-to-ground and air-to-air.
controls.context: The mode decides what the pod looks for.

controls.name: LANTIRN stick: slider
controls.text: A two-way slider on the left of the stick head. It springs back to the middle. Forward selects manual or automatic gain, and aft selects the laser code or, held, the focus. It changes what the S4 hat does.
controls.context: It decides what the S4 hat controls.

controls.name: LANTIRN stick: trigger
controls.text: A two-stage trigger on the front of the stick. The first stage lases the target by hand and the second stage fires the laser and marks the point as a designated target.
controls.context: Lasing means lighting the target with the laser beam.

controls.name: LANTIRN stick: latched laser button
controls.text: A button on the front of the stick. Pressing it fires the laser for 60 seconds. Pressing again restarts the 60 seconds. A press and release of the first trigger stage stops it.
controls.context: It keeps the laser on without holding the trigger.

panels.name: RIO: foot buttons (footwells)
panels.text: Two foot buttons in the RIO's footwells. They let him talk on the intercom or the radio with his feet, so his hands stay on the controls.
panels.context: The left foot button is for the intercom, the right one is for the radio.

controls.name: ICS foot button
controls.text: The button on the left footrest. Pressing it talks to the pilot over the intercom with a cold microphone, which is open only while pressed.
controls.context: It is the RIO's way to speak to the pilot without using his hands.

controls.name: Mic foot button
controls.text: The button on the right footrest. Pressing it transmits on UHF 1, V/UHF 2 or both, depending on the transmitter selection.
controls.context: It is the push-to-talk for the radios.
